card.name: Words just before a quantity like many or a percent
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs (in, by, a comma) right after a verb phrase, where a quantity such as many, a percentage or numerous comes next. Seen in label adverse-event reporting and in general reports.

modes.label: Preposition before a share of cases
modes.description: The word in or by follows a verb like discontinued, resolved, reported or received, and a percentage or many follows.
modes.example: Phosphate binders were received<< by>> 77% of patients who received

modes.label: Verb or punctuation before a large amount
modes.description: A verb or comma sets up a statement about numerous or many instances in general web text.
modes.example: Through his holy and incorruptible relics God has<< performed>> numerous miracles.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning almost, nearly or most, which fit a coming quantity.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text says how many patients or cases, such as many or a percentage.
